description: Restructure the README: make README.md the ENGLISH baseline, move the Japanese content into README.ja.md, add the language-switcher line at the top of each (matching the reference repo daichiasada/kiro-worldriskmap), and replace the current ASCII architecture block with an '## Architecture' section that embeds docs/architecture.png and links the editable .drawio and .svg. Depends on FEAT-001 (the diagram files must exist for the embed/links to resolve). Content must stay TRUTHFUL to the implementation.
steps: The current README.md is predominantly English prose already (it is the source of truth). Produce README.md as the clean ENGLISH baseline: keep all current sections (Overview, Architecture, MLB data strategy, Seasons and the prediction feature, Finished series prediction OFF, Configurable prediction accuracy, JA/EN language switch, Game-detail toggle + detail page, Amazon Bedrock usage, Image assets, Prerequisites, One-command deploy, Local development, steering->lessons map, License) with their truthful content intact. Any Japanese parentheticals embedded in README.md (e.g. '(実証された教訓)') should be removed from the EN baseline and preserved in the JA file.

Insert the language switcher as the third line of README.md (immediately under the H1 title, matching the reference's placement): a blank line then `**English** | [日本語](README.ja.md)` then a blank line.

Replace the fenced ASCII architecture diagram block (the ``` ... ``` box under '## Architecture') with an embed + links, following the reference style:
`![Architecture](docs/architecture.png)`
then a short paragraph: 'The editable diagram is [`docs/architecture.drawio`](docs/architecture.drawio) (open with draw.io / diagrams.net). A vector export [`docs/architecture.svg`](docs/architecture.svg) and a PNG (`docs/architecture.png`) are included.'
Keep the existing truthful bullet list (Frontend / Backend / Data / AI / IaC) and the Monorepo-layout table that follow the diagram.

Create README.ja.md: a faithful JAPANESE translation of the same README.md content (same section order and same truthful facts: multi-season 2024/2025/2026 default 2026, results-only past seasons, prediction only for current season, finished-series prediction OFF, accuracy slider [0,1] default 0.5 clamped to [0.5,0.95], JA default UI toggle persisted to localStorage mlb.lang, Bedrock model us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 inference profile with fallback, DynamoDB cache -> MLB Stats API -> seed fallback, one-command deploy npm install && npm run build && npm run deploy, cdk bootstrap, synth). Its switcher line (third line) is `[English](README.md) | **日本語**`. Its Architecture section embeds the same `![Architecture](docs/architecture.png)` and links the .drawio/.svg (link text may stay in the code-path form).
Confirm the embedded image path and both diagram links point at files that actually exist in docs/ (created by FEAT-001).
Verify no non-doc files changed: `git diff --name-only` should list only README.md, README.ja.md (and docs/* from FEAT-001).
Commit incrementally, e.g. `docs(readme): English baseline + README.ja.md with language switcher and embedded architecture diagram (#12)`, staging only README.md and README.ja.md.
acceptance_criteria: README.md is English-only, has `**English** | [日本語](README.ja.md)` near the top, and its '## Architecture' section embeds `![Architecture](docs/architecture.png)` and links docs/architecture.drawio and docs/architecture.svg (no ASCII diagram remains).
README.ja.md exists, is a faithful Japanese translation covering the same sections, and has `[English](README.md) | **日本語**` near the top.
All diagram references in both files resolve to real files in docs/.

Both READMEs remain truthful to the implementation (routes, Bedrock model id, DynamoDB TTL cache, multi-season/prediction/accuracy behavior, deploy commands) — no claims that contradict infra/lib/mlb-postseason-stack.ts or the backend code.
git diff shows only README.md, README.ja.md changed in this feature (docs/* belong to FEAT-001).
verification: grep -n 'English.*日本語\|日本語.*English' README.md README.ja.md
test -f docs/architecture.png && test -f docs/architecture.drawio && test -f docs/architecture.svg && echo 'diagram files present'
grep -c '```' README.md  (the removed ASCII-diagram fence should be gone; remaining fences are only the real code blocks)
findings: Completed in local commit 21bb674 on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site. README.md is now the clean English baseline: switcher `**English** | [日本語](README.ja.md)` on line 3, the Japanese parenthetical '(実証された教訓)' removed from the judges note, and the fenced ASCII architecture box replaced with `![Architecture](docs/architecture.png)` plus a paragraph linking docs/architecture.drawio and docs/architecture.svg (the truthful Frontend/Backend/Data/AI/IaC bullets and the Monorepo-layout table were kept). Created README.ja.md as a faithful Japanese translation of every section in the same order with switcher `[English](README.md) | **日本語**` on line 3 and the same image embed/links; all technical facts preserved (seasons 2024/2025/2026 default 2026, results-only past seasons, prediction only for current season, finished-series prediction OFF both tiers, accuracy [0,1] default 0.5 identity clamped to [0.5,0.95], &accuracy param, JA-default toggle persisted to localStorage mlb.lang, Bedrock us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 cross-region inference profile with deterministic fallback, DynamoDB cache -> MLB Stats API -> seed fallback, routes GET /bracket and GET+POST /prediction, CloudFront OAC 403/404->index.html, one-command deploy npm install && npm run build && npm run deploy, cdk bootstrap, npm run synth). Verification: switcher and image-embed greps match in both files; docs/architecture.{png,drawio,svg} exist (from FEAT-001); ASCII fence gone; git diff --name-only shows only README.md + README.ja.md. Build/test not run (docs-only change). Only README.md and README.ja.md were staged in the commit; .agents/ left untracked.
